# Filter rows where Position contains '1st'
first_place_years = df[df['Position'].astype(str).str.contains('1st', na=False)]['Year'].unique()
# Find years that are in df but not in first_place_years
all_years = df['Year'].unique()
years_without_first = [year for year in all_years if year not in first_place_years]
# Select one year from the list (e.g., the first one)
answer = years_without_first[0] if years_without_first else None
